title: C型ねじクランプ
description: 木工室や金属加工台に置くC型ねじクランプ。厚い一体C形フレーム、表裏の鋳造風補強、固定の機械加工アンビル、下側ボスを通る実形状の連続らせんねじ、球面座と丸い首振りパッド、端止め付きスライドTハンドルを造形。パッドと上ジョウ間の小さい隙間は意図した固定姿勢です。ねじ回転/締付/首振りはなく、ボス内部の雌ねじや荷重性能は再現しません。一式1点の静的な工具小物です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.204 × 0.248 × 0.042 m、17,444三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A C-frame screw clamp for woodworking or metalworking benches. A thick one-piece C-profile frame, front/back cast-style ribs, fixed machined anvil, geometric continuous helical screw through the lower boss, spherical seat/round swivel pad, and captive sliding T-handle are modeled. The small gap between pad and upper jaw is an intentional fixed pose. Screw rotation, clamping and pad articulation are absent; internal female threads and load performance are not modeled. One complete static tool prop. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.204 × 0.248 × 0.042 m; 17,444 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
